name: PlanAnchor: DWG Plans in Mixed Reality
summary:
PlanAnchor puts your CAD drawings (DWG / DXF) into your real room in mixed reality - at real size, anchored in place and as see-through as you like.

- 2D plans and 3D drawings (incl. solids) at 1:1, any scale or as a tabletop model
- Lay plans on the floor or stand elevations on a wall
- Adjust opacity to see the drawing and the room together
- Match one or two points to real corners; fine-tune by 1 mm and 0.1°
- Turn and tilt on any axis around the drawing's center or its 0,0,0
- Drawings stay in place, e
